create_arm_effector: create an ArmEffector instance with a RobotArm, optional action range override, and robot name
get_action_spec: get the BoundedArray action spec for the robot arm effector from a MuJoCo physics object
set_arm_control: set control commands on the robot arm effector using a numpy array and physics object
get_effector_prefix: get the effector prefix string for identifying the robot arm in multi-arm setups
initialize_arm_episode: initialize a new simulation episode for the robot arm effector with physics and random state
